item.title: The Sphinx
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows raise every concern about the project (priorities, safety, what’s next), and the cat gives the only answer she ever gives: a blank stare, zero commitments, and nothing anyone can quote back later.

item.title: The early-warning system
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows ignore the ‘Normal Tuesday’ calendar. The Culture Team dog’s ears twitch at the Leadership Meeting door first: the dog knows before the calendar does.

item.title: The bragging manager
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows meet the bull who isn’t like other cows: ‘Have you seen my spots?’ Meanwhile the herd is stuck with the reports, and one cow checks a mirror, wondering if the spots are the job.

item.title: Attitude review
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows ask who set the priorities (Urgent, Top priority, Drop everything, empty board). The bull’s answer: let’s stay focused on your attitude.

item.title: The Mascot
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows ask what the office dog actually does here. The answer from the careers-page shoot: it photographs well. No real function, treated as core to ‘culture’, and on the careers page more than any cow.

item.title: Leadership-to-PIP converter
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows watch the bull feed vague instructions, shifting priorities, and impossible deadlines into the Leadership-to-PIP Converter: input poor leadership, output performance concern, while the cow who already delivered just holds the box.

item.title: The diagnosis never includes himself
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, the Chosen One diagnoses everything wrong with the company after three months on the job: the diagnosis, notably, never includes himself.

item.title: Now that's engagement
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows watch the office dog get praised for barking at the alarm, while the cow who quietly fixed the actual problem gets a lonely green checkmark and a whispered ‘…anyone?’

item.title: Found his people
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, the Chosen One announces he’s ‘finally found his people’ at the company: the people, it turns out, are just really good at nodding.

item.title: When everyone's responsible
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows form a perfect circle of pointing: when everyone’s responsible, no cow is responsible, while the ACCOUNTABILITY poster just looks sad.

item.title: The office dog as messenger
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows learn feedback comes pre-chewed: the manager never speaks directly, just sends the office dog to fetch the bad news, tail wagging the whole way.

item.title: Different ways of working
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows meet the raccoon who’s ‘forward deployed’, and the cow behind him who does something else entirely: a ‘PPT engineer,’ building ‘On Track’ one slide at a time, whether or not anything actually is.

item.title: 100% ceremony, 0% change
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows throw a full Agile transformation parade through the office (Scrum, Kanban, ceremonies, drums, flags), while the one cow actually working the bug pile just mutters, ‘Still broken.’

item.title: Graded on a curve
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: This week, our cube-cows get performance reviews from the bull, graded on a curve the bull set, against a bar the bull cleared himself.

item.title: Tapa el sol con un dedo.
item.dc:creator: xynova
item.description: We’ve all watched someone try to sweep a massive, glaring crisis under a rug that’s way too small.
item.sync:pageSocial:
"Tapa el sol con un dedo."
❓ You are patching a gaping hole with a sticker. A trivial fix attempts to hide a massive, undeniable problem, and everyone sees through it. You use it when someone covers a messy room with a blanket before guests arrive, or when a manager proposes minor budget cuts to mask huge company debt.
AND: You hear the exasperated sigh of 'We can all see the giant elephant in the room' when a teammate suggests cutting the coffee budget to fix a six-figure deficit, or when someone insists on taking an aspirin to cure a broken leg.
🔤 IN ENGLISH: • Burying your head in the sand • Ignoring the elephant in the room • Turning a blind eye
🟣 W37: Street-Wisdom 💬🇻🇪
This is part of an experiment: we are keeping count of how many Venezuelan sayings we can translate before the regime finally changes. Call it a cultural stopwatch for a political era.
In a world where American culture is often exported and adopted globally, this project "exports back" Venezuelan street wisdom as a tiny contribution to a more balanced cultural trade landscape.
